verdict.rationale: Gitea is a self-hosted Git service, so a natural-language command interface is a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no built-in natural-language or assistant interface. The only related item is an official MCP server listing (gitea-probe-3). That belongs to the separate MCP-server story and would only let an external AI client drive Gitea, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: any first-party natural-language command interface, plus documentation or hands-on evidence of using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
